messages:
Ava: quick follow-up after yesterday's outage. want to lock owners for SLO/SLA changes and recurring-spike tasks.

Diego: good call. what are you proposing?

Ava: proposal: temporarily relax p95 from 200ms -> 230ms for standard tier while cache fixes roll out; keep availability SLA at 99.9% but add a note about degraded tail. owner for SLO change: Diego; due: 2024-11-19.

Rina: I'll take dashboard work: add a spike-detection panel, per-route p95 heatmap, and an annotation layer for deploys. ETA 2024-11-16.

Ava: runbook updates: add a section to differentiate cache cold-start vs upstream throttling and steps to collect KV metrics. owner: Rina; runbook due same day as dashboard.

Diego: I'll draft customer-facing SLA wording: "Committed: p95 <= 230ms (transitional), 99.9% availability. We'll notify customers when p95 is outside target for 6+ hours." PR by 2024-11-18 EOD.

ops-bot: Incident #2024-11-14-03 acknowledged. Postmortem draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/pm/2024-11-14-spike-draft

Rina: for spike detection i'll use a kurtosis-based alert + a short rolling-window anomaly. will add a synthetic that hits hot prefixes to verify warm-path. snippet: ```bash
rdw-synth --job canary-prefix-check --freq 10m --keys 50
```

Diego: error budget config: don't change the calc, but add a burn alert that pages after 30m sustained burn > 20% of daily budget. owner: Ava.

Ava: agreed. i'll set escalation: page SRE primary after critical; otherwise slack alert to #eng-oncall.

Rina: dashboard link (wip): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/spikes/1745001. i'll include annotation layer and hover notes for deploy IDs.

Diego: add to the postmortem tracker with owners and dates. i'll file the SLO PR and tag legal for customer notice wording.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: dashboards/spike-panels by Rina -> staging 2024-11-16 02:30 UTC.

Ava: thanks. i'll run daily check-ins until items are closed and then schedule a retro to review recurring pattern analysis. :eyes:
